# clinic/connectors — generated, do not edit

Every file here except this one is written by `scripts/generate-connectors.sh`
and uploaded by `scripts/register-connectors.sh`. Edits made here are lost the
next time the configs are generated.

To change a connector, edit its template in `scripts/templates/` or the table
lists in `../sync/tables/`, then run:

```
bash scripts/generate-connectors.sh
bash scripts/register-connectors.sh
```

Passwords appear here only as `${...}` placeholders; `register-connectors.sh`
fills them in from `.env` when it uploads. Only this README is tracked by git.
